description: This file defines inline functions, checks, and utilities related to tensor shape validation and manipulation within the ATen library of PyTorch. It includes functions for shape compatibility checks during tensor concatenation, tensor splitting, and tensor dimension validation, as well as a tensor cloning function preserving strides.

methods.name: clone_preserve_strides
methods.description: Creates a clone of the input tensor while preserving its stride layout.

methods.name: bool cat_should_skip_tensor(const Tensor & t)
methods.description: Determines if a tensor should be skipped during concatenation based on its sym_numel and dimension.

methods.name: void check_cat_shape_except_dim(const Tensor & first,const Tensor & second,int64_t dimension,int64_t index)
methods.description: Checks if two tensors have compatible shapes for concatenation along a specific dimension, excluding that dimension.

methods.name: void check_cat_no_zero_dim(const MaterializedITensorListRef & tensors)
methods.description: Validates that all tensors in a list are not zero-dimensional for concatenation.

methods.name: int64_t get_num_splits(const Tensor & self,int64_t split_size,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Calculates the number of splits for a tensor given a split size and dimension, with validation.

methods.name: bool have_same_ndims(TensorList tensors)
methods.description: Checks if all tensors in a list have the same number of dimensions.

methods.name: void leading_dimension_matches(TensorList tensors,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Validates that all tensors have matching sizes in dimensions before a given axis.

methods.name: int64_t preprocess_chunk_cat_inputs(TensorList tensors,int64_t dim,int64_t num_chunks)
methods.description: Validates and preprocesses input tensors for chunked concatenation, ensuring consistent dtype, device, and dimensions.

ctags.name: check_cat_shape_except_dim
ctags.signature: (const Tensor & first,const Tensor & second,int64_t dimension,int64_t index)
